strategic_read: This domain is the program's conscience and its best-built artifact, and both facts are now liabilities because nothing consumes it. Three honest deaths are on the record — the founding 15-paper taxonomy (ALETHEIA, March), the learnable-gradient-field reading of the kill ledger (Day-4 learner, May), and the 2,351-promotion count (M0.5 replay, June) — and in each case the substrate's own instruments did the killing, which validates the falsification-first design as engineering. But the load-bearing/ceremonial split is stark: what actually bears load today is the kernel's discipline mechanics (verified passing), the frozen-contract manifests, and the honest results docs; what is ceremonial is the promotion pipeline (gates on metadata shape, count is a fossil), the exclusion certificate (placeholder hashes), the 'ledger' (aggregate counts of first-failing falsifiers, not kill vectors), and the README's own opcode count. The domain's forward value is concentrated in three built-but-unwired bridges, all cheap: (1) guard the eager cypari import so the arsenal opens on any machine — hours; (2) flip F2 content verification from observation into the promote gate and stamp promote_score/formula_version on durable records — days, and it converts the falsification thesis from asserted to enforced for the first time; (3) make the one-call-site reasoning_quality_emit integration so the H-R1 reasoning question can run on real data. The gradient-field north star is not dead but is starved: the margin-space signal (126,983x) is the only surviving route, and it requires per-record vector persistence from a *running* generation loop plus access to the F:-drive corpus — i.e., it requires exactly the organism/metabolization decision the June dissent demanded. Recommendation: treat this domain as a finished instrument; spend zero further effort on new substrate primitives (five stub suites already document that pattern's failure) and route all effort to the three wirings and to locating/mounting the off-repo ledger. If after that the margin-space signal fails at scale, the substrate thesis is fully falsified and the domain can be archived with its kill record as the deliverable.
